title: Serde ignore_unknown allows forward compatibility with LocalAPI spec evolution
description: Response types (StatusResponse, WhoIsNode, UserProfile, WhoIsResponse) use #[serde(default)] and serde's default behavior to ignore unknown fields. Tests (integration.rs lines 300-310, lib.rs lines 245-250) verify this explicitly with fixtures containing future fields. This is correct: Tailscale evolves the LocalAPI spec and clients must tolerate new fields. Keep this forward-compat design.
